name: Wix
description_en:
Wix is a hosted website platform offering AI-assisted creation, templates, visual editing and business tools such as stores, bookings and blogs. Free sites use a Wix URL and branding; site upgrades add domain connection, branding removal and larger feature/capacity allowances. The standard Wix Light/Core/Business/Business Elite plans are distinct from Wix Studio plans and custom Enterprise arrangements.

Evaluate the exact editor, business workflow and plan before choosing. Paid storage, collaborators and payment features differ, while domains, business email, apps and processing can have separate charges. Wix explicitly ties a standard Wix site to its own infrastructure, so content ownership does not mean the complete site can be exported to another host.
description_zh:
Wix 是提供 AI 辅助创建、模板、可视化编辑及商店、预约、博客等业务工具的托管网站平台。免费站使用 Wix 地址和品牌，升级增加域名连接、移除品牌及更大功能/容量。标准 Light/Core/Business/Business Elite 与 Wix Studio 及 Enterprise 定制方案不同。

选择前应确认具体编辑器、业务流程和方案。付费存储、协作者及支付能力不同，域名、企业邮件、应用和处理费可能另计。Wix 明确标准站点依赖自有基础设施，内容所有权不等于能将完整网站导出到其他主机。

core_features.explanation_en: Start from a prompt or template, refine the design and explicitly publish; saving or previewing alone does not update the public site.
core_features.explanation_zh: 从提示或模板开始，修改设计后明确发布，仅保存或预览不更新公开站点。

core_features.explanation_en: Light/Core/Business/Elite show 2/50/100GB/unlimited storage and 2/5/10/100 collaborators; payment acceptance begins at Core in the observed cards.
core_features.explanation_zh: Light/Core/Business/Elite 列存储 2/50/100GB/不限，协作者 2/5/10/100，实读卡片从 Core 开始列接受支付。

core_features.explanation_en: A standard Wix site must run on Wix servers; an externally registered domain can point to it, but that is not site export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 标准 Wix 网站需运行在 Wix 服务器，可连接外部注册域名，但这不是网站导出。

pricing.summary_en: Free Wix URL/branding; paid standard and Studio plans have different quotas. Reliable current numeric checkout price not established from inconsistent direct text/no-number rendered view. Yearly displays are upfront; domains/email/apps/processing separate.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费 Wix 地址/品牌，标准和 Studio 付费配额不同。直接文本不一致、渲染视图无金额，未取得可靠当前结账价。年付显示为预付，域名/邮件/应用/支付处理另计。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Identify the editor and verify the live result
sections.title_zh: 确认编辑器并检查线上结果
sections.en: For the Wix Editor workflow read here, create from a prompt/template, replace sample content, use Preview, then click Publish → View Site and return with Done. Save alone does not make changes public; later edits require republishing. The live address is the free wixsite.com URL or a connected domain. Test menus, mobile layout, forms and the desired store/booking action on that URL. Search-indexing controls are not access control for confidential material. The cited procedure is for Wix Editor; Studio and Harmony have separate documentation, so confirm which editor is in the account before reusing instructions. No account or publication action was executed.
sections.zh: 本次读取的 Wix Editor 流程为从提示/模板创建、替换样例、Preview，再点击 Publish → View Site，使用 Done 返回。仅 Save 不会公开修改，之后编辑需重新发布。线上地址为免费 wixsite.com URL 或已连接域名，应在该 URL 测试菜单、手机布局、表单和目标商店/预约行动。搜索索引控制不是机密资料的访问控制。引用流程针对 Wix Editor，Studio 和 Harmony 有独立文档，复用指令前应确认账户编辑器。本次未执行账户或发布。

sections.title_en: Select capacity and commerce before shopping by price
sections.title_zh: 先按容量和电商选档再比较价格
sections.en: The observed standard cards list Light 2GB storage/two collaborators; Core 50GB/five; Business 100GB/ten; Business Elite unlimited storage/100. Core and above list accepting payments, eCommerce and scheduling, with increasing business/marketing tiers. Studio is separately named in the storage guide as Basic/Standard/Plus/Elite, with 10/50/120GB/unlimited storage; do not map these to standard Wix plan names. For a store, confirm country/provider, transaction rates, recurring payment behavior, tax and application costs. A plan’s payment capability is not a guarantee every payment method or business model is supported.
sections.zh: 实读标准卡片列出 Light 2GB/两名协作者，Core 50GB/五名，Business 100GB/十名，Business Elite 不限存储/100 名。Core 及以上列出接受支付、电商和预约，并逐档增加业务/营销能力。存储指南另将 Studio 命名为 Basic/Standard/Plus/Elite，存储为 10/50/120GB/不限，不能映射为标准 Wix 同名方案。商店应确认国家/支付商、交易费、周期付款、税费和应用成本。方案能接受支付不保证每种支付方式或业务模式都受支持。

sections.title_en: Get a local checkout quote and redeem the right voucher
sections.title_zh: 取得地区结账报价并正确兑换域名券
sections.en: The pricing page says displayed prices are yearly subscriptions paid upfront, location/currency vary and final tax depends on billing address. The direct capture contained inconsistent GST/discount and numeric fragments, while the normal rendered view exposed no numeric amounts; this draft does not promote those fragments into a confirmed starting price. Confirm the actual local checkout total and renewal. The FAQ says most eligible first-time yearly/multi-year plans include a one-year new-domain voucher, redeemable within 60 days; renewals, existing-plan upgrades and existing-domain renewal are excluded. A domain may be bought/managed elsewhere and connected to a paid Wix site. Personalized Google Workspace email is a separate purchase.
sections.zh: 定价页称显示价格为年订阅预付，地区/货币不同，最终税费取决于账单地址。直接读取出现不一致 GST/折扣和金额碎片，正常渲染视图却未显示金额，本草稿不将这些碎片写成已确认起价。应确认实际当地结账总额与续费。FAQ 称多数符合条件的首次年付/多年方案含一年新域名券，60 天内兑换，续费、既有方案升级和已有域名续费被排除。域名可在外部购买/管理，再连接到付费 Wix 站；Google Workspace 品牌邮件另购。

sections.title_en: Understand free quotas and the refund clock
sections.title_zh: 理解免费配额与退款时钟
sections.en: The storage article gives Free up to 500MB storage and 1GB bandwidth, but the refund article describes the returned Free site with 500MB bandwidth. Preserve that official discrepancy and check the account allowance. New Premium/Studio plans, monthly or annual, have a 14-day refund window; renewals and upgrades of an existing plan are excluded. Eligible cancellation deactivates premium benefits immediately and refunds to the original method can take up to 45 business days. Cancellation after that initial window instead stops auto-renewal while the plan runs to expiry. Domain/business-email purchases are separate. A plan starts when bought and cannot be paused or deferred. On deactivation/expiry, the site reverts to a free Wix URL/branding rather than being deleted under this guide.
sections.zh: 存储文章称 Free 最多 500MB 存储、1GB 带宽，但退款文章将恢复 Free 的网站描述为 500MB 带宽，需保留官方差异并检查账户额度。新 Premium/Studio 的月付和年付均有 14 天退款期，排除续费及既有方案升级。符合条件的取消立即停用高级能力，退至原支付方式可能需最多 45 个工作日。超过初始期限的取消仅停止自动续费，方案运行到期。域名/企业邮件购买单独处理。方案购买即开始，不能暂停或延后。该指南称停用/到期后网站转为免费 Wix 地址/品牌，并非删除。

sections.title_en: Content ownership is not a portable website runtime
sections.title_zh: 内容所有权不等于可迁移运行环境
sections.en: The export/hosting article says Wix content belongs to its creator but the standard Wix site must operate on Wix servers because it depends on proprietary SaaS services. External domain registration is allowed; embedding the site elsewhere does not create independent hosting and may break analytics/search behavior, with no Wix support for that embedding. No general open-source or full downloadable-site entitlement is established. Wix can fit a business comfortable with managed hosting and app-based operations. If own-server deployment, independent application source or a complete store/member migration is essential, obtain a concrete alternative architecture and export plan before adopting it. No editor, payment, app integration, quota behavior, refund or migration was tested here.
sections.zh: 导出/托管文章称内容归创作者，但标准 Wix 网站因依赖专有 SaaS 服务必须在 Wix 服务器运行。允许外部注册域名，将站点嵌入其他页面不产生独立托管，且可能影响分析/搜索，Wix 不支持该嵌入行为。本次未确立通用开源或完整可下载站点权利。接受托管和应用式运营的企业可考虑 Wix；如必须自有服务器部署、独立应用源码或完整商店/会员迁移，应在采用前取得具体替代架构及导出计划。本次未实测编辑器、支付、应用集成、额度行为、退款或迁移。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.zh: 未执行 Wix/Studio/Harmony 账户、支付、预约、权限、退款或数据迁移。
